notes: Replaced the private MP3 match-track workflow with the user-provided YouTube source mH2wmyeiIpA (Cyberpunk: Edgerunners / This Fffire video).
The YouTube iframe API is preloaded during Gateway boot; the video remains visually hidden until the transition but its audio begins on the first exact typed-name registry match.
ESTABLISH LINK retries/resumes playback from the button user gesture in case the browser blocked autoplay on the typed-name event.
Extended the blue 3D connection sequence to roughly 4.4 seconds before handoff and made the already-running video fade in from behind the blue field during SESSION TRANSFER.
After ACTIVATED // CONNECTION ESTABLISHED, the blue system fades away and the YouTube intro owns the screen.
Added a SKIP INTRO control; skipping fades the video/audio out and returns to the live Foundry scene. Natural video end does the same automatically.
Removed the obsolete GM SET MATCH TRACK importer and old HTMLAudio match-track state.
Changed the 3D transition centerpiece from SESSION INIT to ACTIVATED // CONNECTION ESTABLISHED.
Existing final connection status remains consistent with the new centerpiece wording.
Music, 3D motion, and transition timing are unchanged.
Removed the browser speech-synthesis AI voice from the SESSION INIT transition.
The final on-screen text remains ACTIVATED // CONNECTION ESTABLISHED.
Music, custom transition sound effects, 3D animation, and scene handoff remain unchanged.
Reduced the final hold because no spoken line needs time to finish.
Added exact typed-name music trigger to the custom Entry Gateway: the configured match track begins the first time the typed identifier exactly matches Ponyboy, Derke, Sasha, or Zach.
Match music starts with a short fade-in at restrained volume and continues through authentication, SESSION INIT, Gateway close, and into live play rather than restarting between phases.
Added a GM-only SET MATCH TRACK / REPLACE MATCH TRACK button that imports a local audio file through Foundry FilePicker into private world data storage and saves its path as a FEHA world setting.
The uploaded Franz Ferdinand instrumental is intentionally not committed to the public GitHub repository; the private-world importer keeps copyrighted music outside public source control.
DEV patch teardown stops and clears any active Gateway match music.
Built a dedicated original Web Audio soundscape for the 3D SESSION INIT transition instead of recycling ordinary UI SFX.
Opening cue now combines a stereo-filtered noise rush, low rising neural tone, and high spatial sweep to match the rings and particles flying toward the viewer.
Added unique route-lock, three-note neural-handshake, session-transfer whoosh, and final connection impact/shimmer cues.
SESSION LIVE now displays ACTIVATED // CONNECTION ESTABLISHED and attempts to speak 'Activated. Connection established.' using the browser's available English system voice.
The final live state now holds long enough for the spoken connection cue to land before the 3D cut back into the Foundry scene.
Custom transition audio gracefully falls back to existing FEHA sounds if Web Audio is unavailable.

Internet reference research used Pixabay's Futuristic Transition by DRAGON-STUDIO and AI Interface Activation by wings_of_freedom as motion/style references; no third-party audio was hotlinked or committed.
Renamed the 3D transition centerpiece from LINK START to SESSION INIT.

Removed remaining FullDive/anime-style copy in favor of more grounded system language: INITIALIZING SESSION, NEURAL HANDSHAKE, NEURAL BRIDGE SYNCHRONIZED, SESSION TRANSFER, and SESSION CHANNEL OPENING.
3D fly-through motion, timing, sounds, and scene handoff are unchanged.
Rebuilt Link Start into a SAO-inspired 3D full-dive transition rather than a flat cyberpunk terminal animation.
Added true CSS perspective and Z-space motion: concentric rings, radial rails, particles, and the LINK START title travel from deep negative Z toward and past the viewer.
The camera drifts forward through the tunnel and performs a final lunge at SESSION LIVE, creating a fly-into-you / pass-through-the-interface sensation.
Removed dense code-column and large character-art emphasis from the Link Start transition in favor of a cleaner centered ceremonial full-dive composition.
Changed transition copy toward INITIALIZING FULLDIVE LINK, CONSCIOUSNESS HANDSHAKE, SENSORY BRIDGE SYNCHRONIZED, and IMMERSION GATE OPENING.
Added a radial activation flash and forward zoom cut when SESSION LIVE triggers.
Added a full-screen LINK START transition after ESTABLISH LINK and before returning to live play.

Link Start runs through ESTABLISHING NEURAL LINK, NEURAL ROUTE VERIFIED, SESSION HANDSHAKE, FINALIZING SESSION, and SESSION LIVE phases over roughly 2.6 seconds.
Timed session_join, scan, confirm, and compatibility_ok sounds are synchronized to the full-screen connection phases.
The existing Gateway remains underneath until SESSION LIVE; it is then removed while the Link Start overlay owns the screen, followed by a glitch-style hard cut back into the Foundry scene.
The Link Start overlay reuses the existing private CP2077 asset bridge for frame/line/buffer grammar when available, without committing proprietary media to the repository.
Added a dedicated session_join event to the FEHA sound engine with a restrained fallback connection hit.
ESTABLISH LINK now plays a unique two-stage join cue: muted metallic connection hit followed by a soft confirmation chirp.
Removed the previous door-open cue from the ESTABLISH LINK pointer press so join audio fires once at the actual connection moment instead of stacking.

No MutationObserver or continuous polling was added; the anti-freeze one-shot architecture remains intact.

Changed Zach/operator scaling from a constant 1.5x size to progressive zoom scaling
Zach now renders at normal size at 100% zoom and grows smoothly to 1.5x at maximum zoom
No actor-node, topology, relay, or Quickhack behavior changed in this pass
Zach/operator portrait size is now based on the real Foundry scene token footprint instead of an arbitrary operator UI size
At 100% zoom Zach's portrait matches his real token footprint; at maximum zoom it grows smoothly to 1.5x that token size
The decorative operator frame and rings now scale around the token-relative portrait instead of defining Zach's size
Responsive rules no longer resize the operator independently from its token-relative size
Selected JACK IN actors now appear as a large portrait in the bottom-left TARGET LOCK panel
Switching targets updates the bottom-left portrait, name, relation styling, and LOCKED state in place without rerendering JACK IN
Deselecting hides the portrait and returns the panel to NO TARGET / SELECT ACTOR
This pass does not change actor topology, actor square sizing, zoom behavior, or Quickhack behavior
Opening or previewing a Quickhack resolution no longer spends RAM
Returning to the network or closing the resolution consumes zero RAM
Damage Quickhacks now spend RAM only after APPLY DAMAGE is committed
Non-damage Quickhacks now expose APPLY EFFECT and spend RAM only when that action is committed
Each resolution marks its RAM commit so the same Quickhack resolution cannot spend RAM twice
Resolution footer now shows RAM COST until the commit action succeeds, then changes to RAM SPENT
Quickhack resolution no longer rerenders JACK IN just to open the result panel, preserving the live scene background
Restored JACK IN network visualization as direct operator-to-actor trace lines only
Trace endpoints use the existing exact operator and actor scene coordinates
Hostile traces are yellow, friendly traces cyan, and the selected target trace turns red
No relay boxes, relay branches, route nodes, or packet dots are rendered in this pass
Target selection recolors the matching trace in place without rerendering JACK IN
Closing a Quickhack resolution preview now refreshes RUN button availability immediately
RUN buttons re-enable after × / RETURN TO NET when the selected target is still valid and enough RAM remains
No RAM, damage, effect, targeting, or topology behavior changed in this pass
Clicking an already-selected JACK IN actor now deselects that same actor
Deselecting clears the target panel, selected actor styling, selected trace state, and disables Quickhack RUN buttons until another actor is selected
Selecting a different actor still releases the previous target and locks the new one
Added a dedicated FEHA Camera subsystem with GM-authoritative Camera actor creation and token placement
The Camera subsystem bootstraps an Actor folder named Camera and creates a per-operator/per-user Camera actor with OWNER permission for the requesting operator user
Added JACK IN CAMERA placement mode: the ghost marker follows the JACK IN map and clicking deploys a real Camera token at the matching active Scene coordinate
Existing Camera tokens render back into JACK IN at their real Scene positions and are excluded from normal actor targeting
Camera markers remain constant screen-size during JACK IN zoom and the placement tool can be cancelled by right-click or pressing CAMERA again
Camera tokens store default FOV metadata for the next pass, but FOV angle/range/rotation editing is intentionally not exposed yet
knownLimitations: Camera placement is implemented in 0.10.38; FOV preset selection, rotation, range visualization, and post-placement camera editing are the next camera pass.
Turret ROTATE/FIRE still require a future turret adapter
Status effects and non-damage Quickhack secondary effects are still not yet Active Effects
Quickhack rules still use effectText parsing as a legacy bridge pending explicit schema migration
The dev loader remains GM-only; player-client multiplayer device testing requires the modular runtime to be loaded through the actual FEHA module or an equivalent player-safe dev bootstrap
